81022.subject: Weekly Recap: Ledger Blames an Organized Group for Wallet Implants
81022.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

**Ledger** spent the week tracing tampered hardware wallets from one Southeast Asian reseller to European stores, and on Thursday it blamed an organized group that worked for months. Bitquery counts $102 million taken from 324 wallets. The same week, a Wall Street Journal report said **Tether** paid a firm co-owned by Bo Hines while he led the White House push for the GENIUS Act, and the EU named USDC its first significant e-money token.

Onchain, **Starknet** opened a vote on leaving Ethereum to become its own Layer 1, while L2BEAT data showed almost no L2 value sits on chains where users can exit before an upgrade. **Uniswap** and **PancakeSwap** each moved to pay liquidity providers more, and Jupiter's 1,000x YOLO product logged $1 billion in volume in a day. **Richard Heart** was detained in Istanbul on an Interpol notice, and HEX fell 31%.

Enjoy!

## STRK’s L1 Bet: Eli Ben-Sasson on Starknet’s Exit Plan

Youtube: 🟢 LIVE : STRK’s L1 Bet: Eli Ben-Sasson on Starknet’s Exit Plan (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q49tpDpJ7O0)

**Camila Russo** asks StarkWare CEO **Eli Ben-Sasson** why Starknet is weighing a move off Ethereum, what has to be decided first, and when holders vote on a design. **[Watch the full conversation.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q49tpDpJ7O0)**

———————————————————————————

# Top Stories This Week

## Ledger Blamed an Organized Group for Its Wallet Implants

The week started with a [second tampered Ledger from MediaMarkt](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/buyer-reports-second-tampered-ledger-from-mediamarkt-calls-for-recall) in Germany. On Tuesday, Ledger said the implant [reads the recovery phrase off the screen and sends it over LTE](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/ledger-says-cryptobilis-sold-wallet-implants-transmit-recovery-phrases-over-lte), and Genuine Check cannot detect it. Mark Karpelès found one in a [Flex bought at Singapore's airport](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/karpel-s-says-airport-bought-ledger-flex-contained-spy-implant), MediaMarktSaturn [pulled Ledger products in 11 countries](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/mediamarktsaturn-pulls-ledger-products-amid-tampering-reports), and Ledger [halted sales in seven Asian markets](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/ledger-asks-resellers-to-halt-sales-in-seven-asian-markets). On Thursday, Ledger said [an organized group spent months and millions](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/ledger-blames-organized-group-for-months-long-wallet-tampering-campaign) fitting implants to genuine devices and reselling them. Authorized sellers must now keep stock off shelves. Every confirmed loss still traces to CryptoBilis buyers, and Ledger has not given a victim count. Our [guide](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/ledger-wallet-tampering-what-is-confirmed-and-what-owners-should-know) sets out what owners should do.
